coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variables (38%, rounded): query direction, retrieval accuracy including log-likelihood, and interaction modes through conversational QA versus base-model cloze completion.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata cohorts and substitutes different models for all specified models. Uses fixed temperature 0 rather than model-dependent temperature settings. Does not specify the same fixed dataset-creation, testing, and visualization scripts. Replaces t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests with McNemar tests and mixed-effects regression.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not match the expected directional-bias conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied stating that child-to-parent retrieval outperforms parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse in real-world knowledge.
